metadata.source: PSOC - Disabling of IP address-based cookie binding protection in Dataverse.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Disabling of IP address-based cookie binding protection in Dataverse
properties.description: Identifies disabling of cookie binding protection in Dataverse. See https://docs.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/block-cookie-replay-attack
properties.query:
DataverseActivity
| where Message == "Update" and EntityName == "organization"
| mv-expand Fields
| where Fields.Name == "enableipbasedcookiebinding" and Fields.Value == 'False'
| summarize CookieBindingDisabled = min(TimeGenerated)
    by CookieBindingDisabledBy = UserId, InstanceUrl
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("CookieBindingDisabledBy",""))

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: IP address-based cookie binding was disabled by in {{InstanceUrl}}.
